notes.title: Mystic Academy: Escape Room VR Edition
notes.content:
🎉 Big News for Mystic Academy! 🎉

 We’re going VR!
We’re teaming up with our amazing friends at Mameshiba Games to bring you Mystic Academy: Escape Room VR Edition, an immersive spellcasting adventure like never before. You can wishlist it now on Steam!

notes.title: v1.0.7 Fixes
notes.content:
*If you saved after half-attempting some puzzles, they would start in this state upon loading, which could be confusing.
*Fixed colliders in the central room of arches of the Alien Temple.
*You cold grab an item in the Biolaboratory before solving the corresponding puzzle. This has been solved.
*Time-based puzzles now go even slower with each attempt.

notes.title: v1.0.6 Minor fixes
notes.content:
v1.0.6

*Fix: two puzzles of the Alien Temple were not correctly reset when loading a save game. This has been fixed.

notes.title: v1.0.5 Minor Fix
notes.content:
v1.0.5 

*Fix: The Gods Statue Puzzle in the Burial Chamber was in an incorrect state if you tried solving it, saved and load. This has been fixed.

notes.title: v1.0.4 Minor Fix
notes.content:
v1.0.4 

*Minor Fix: One chest in the Egypt Burial Chamber was not opening again when solved if you loaded a save file. This has been fixed.

notes.title: Pyramids and Aliens ~ Now Available!
notes.content:
Dear adventurer,

The wait is over! Pyramids and Aliens: Escape Room is now available on Steam. Dive into a thrilling journey where ancient Egyptian mysteries collide with extraterrestrial intrigue. Solve challenging puzzles, uncover hidden secrets, and unravel a story that will keep you on the edge of your seat. Are you ready to face the unknown?

We’d love to hear your thoughts—leaving a review helps us tremendously.
Thanks and enjoy the game!
Kiko

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2833640

notes.title: Pyramids and Aliens ~ Launch Date Revealed!
notes.content:
Hello,
